userPrompt: What is the hardest natural substance?
responseText:
**Diamond** is the hardest natural substance.

It tops the Mohs scale at 10 and has the highest Vickers hardness (~70–100 GPa) of any naturally occurring material, due to its rigid tetrahedral carbon lattice. Nothing harder exists in nature; synthetic materials like aggregated diamond nanorods or Q-carbon exceed it, but they are lab-made.
